plugin.name: CDShelf
plugin.title: CD Shelf
plugin.desc: A jewel-case style album shelf for Lyrion Music Server, based on the original project by Reddit user ChrisHoppyBot. Includes Material integration, player selection, standard and full-width views.
plugin.changes: Adds an A-Z library jump strip. Select a letter to jump directly to that section of the library, following the current Artist or Album sort. Letters with no matching entries are disabled. Includes the 0.7.5 playback controls and removal of volume and screensaver mode.
plugin.creator: ChrisHoppyBot; Joe Leech
